propositions: preview and legacy --mode dry-run passes perform remote Jira add_label and set_entity_property writes during pending-binding recovery despite being documented as no-write modes
run_differs._run_differs_outbound gates recovery on `if not scoped_ids:` alone, without checking the persist/no-write axis
the recovery gate lacks the compose-both-axes pattern used by sibling invariant-filing and write-boundary gates in the same codebase
a no-write unscoped pass with a keyed-pending binding will execute client.add_label(key, rebar-id:local_id) and client.set_entity_property(key, local_id) against the remote issue
the fix gates recovery on `if not scoped_ids and ctx.persist:` to suppress remote recovery writes on no-write passes while preserving live-pass recovery behavior
regression test drives _run_differs_outbound with a keyed-pending binding on persist=False and asserts zero remote identity writes
